workflow.decision: Start a source review by identifying dependency behavior, then check effective feature settings and input reachability before treating a catalogued issue as applicable. A matching dependency alone leaves necessary gates unresolved.

When a complex attempt fails, separate whether the behavioral boundary is reached from whether stronger consequences are possible. Resolve the narrower observable question without treating that observation as proof of unrestricted impact.

Revisit an environmental failure hypothesis at the actual type-resolution operation and supported representation category. Preserve the distinction between an initial conjecture and a later source-reported explanation.
If tutorials leave a supporting capability unclear, inspect the existing tool's implementation and module boundaries before assuming it must be reimplemented.

limitations: This is a historical application-specific report; dependency presence and source configuration do not establish current-release or deployed-artifact exposure.
The disabled feature and absent direct input are the author's review findings, not independently verified coverage of every input route.

The initial class-loading explanation was explicitly conjectural. The updates attribute more detailed analysis to an external article and a commenter; the quoted resolver limitation is their report, not an independently established universal runtime fact.
The reported network observation supports only the tested behavior. The article does not supply a matched negative control, repeated-trial denominator or observer-effect analysis.
An initial configuration mismatch and later runtime failure show that assumptions mattered; neither a failed attempt nor the narrow observation establishes the full security consequence by itself.
No target testing, exploit attachment retrieval or independent reproduction was performed. Final impact remains author-reported, and the article provides no verified shipped remediation.

candidate_additions.guidance: Pair dependency triage with an applicability ledger recording effective feature settings and controllable input routes. Keep a catalogued issue as a hypothesis until its necessary gates are supported.

After a complex trial fails, narrow the question to harmless behavioral reachability. Retain controls, failed assumptions and observation limits; neither failure nor a small observable side effect automatically establishes safety or stronger impact.

A reconstruction failure may reflect the effective resolver's representation support rather than absence of a risky boundary. Compare the actual resolution operation and rejected type category before generalizing the result.

When documentation leaves an existing tool's capability unclear, review its modules and interfaces before reimplementing support. Record source-inspected functionality separately from behavior actually observed.
